FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Skills update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a configurable skill floor and medicine-based merc heal rate boosts.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds configurable skill floor. Specialist skill levels below this floor do not provide bonuses
Specialist medicine skills now increase the rate at which mercs heal

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Skill floor change
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Split the skill floor setting to be per-Specialist type.

patchNoteLines.li: The minimum skill level for a specialist to provide their bonus can now be individually configured for each type of Specialist
